test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Gita said, “I lost my umbrella.”

options.text: Gita said that she had lost her umbrella.
Gita said that I lost my umbrella.
Gita told me that he lost her umbrella.
Gita expressed that she has lost her umbrella.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** It is used to report what someone said without using their exact words.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• In indirect speech, the past simple tense "lost" changes to past perfect "had lost."
 
• The pronoun "I" is changed to "she" to match the subject "Gita."
 
• The possessive "my" changes to "her" to reflect Gita’s ownership of the umbrella.
 
 
 
• **Correct Indirect Speech:** "Gita said that she had lost her umbrella."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Gita said that I lost my umbrella."

 
 
• Incorrect because "I" should change to "she" (referring to Gita).
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Gita told me that he lost her umbrella."
 
 
• Incorrect because "he" is wrongly used instead of "she" for Gita.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Gita expressed that she has lost her umbrella."
 
 
• Incorrect because "has lost" should be in past perfect "had lost."
